criteria.criterion: Design separate, directly invokable country-radio and NTS experiences with clear prompts and accessible in-app help while preserving clean minimal layouts and shared playback ownership.
criteria.evidence: The candidate registers open_country_radio, open_nts_radio, search_nts_archive and pause_dial. Protocol tests assert distinct launch modes and app-only tool visibility; UI bundle tests and player/coordinator tests pass. Help examples and labels are present in the shared renderer. npm test: 56 passed, 0 failed. This verifies implementation and local protocol behavior, not observed model routing in the ChatGPT host.
criteria.method: Inspected approved PRODUCT/TECH and current tool registrations, shared view/player source and MCP server protocol tests; ran npm test.

criteria.criterion: Investigate NTS archived-show keyword search and stream resolution using the owner Omarchy NTS reference and current primary sources; distinguish supported results, metadata, playback formats, expiring URLs and failure modes.
criteria.evidence: Fresh search returned 12 normalized results including show and episode rows. One returned Floating Points episode resolved to HLS AAC candidate on the single approved SoundCloud media origin; evidence stores origin, path, query key names, and expiry presence only. Source/tests enforce NTS alias/path validation, exact media origin/path, expiry checks and playlist origin validation. See evidence/run-0fec9b5003c6/fresh-nts-check.json. This establishes one metadata/resolution path, not host playback.
criteria.method: Ran one bounded live search and selected episode resolution through the candidate's searchArchive/resolveEpisode methods; inspected current source policy and ran archive tests.

criteria.criterion: Define discoverable prompts and concrete tool routing for opening, searching, playing and pausing; state explicit browser gesture requirements and the supported cross-thread control scope without implying cross-device identity.
criteria.evidence: The four model-visible tools and app-only archive tools are registered and protocol-tested. Help contains natural-language examples and asks the user to press Play in-app. Playback and pause-control use the shared coordinator; code/tests keep cross-thread claims bounded to shared browser context and report acknowledgement states. Local fixture's explicit Play/Pause/Resume actions succeeded. Actual model routing and same-browser cross-thread behavior inside ChatGPT remain unobserved and are covered as blocked under criterion 5.
criteria.method: Inspected tool descriptions, UI Help copy and coordinator implementation; ran MCP server protocol and lifecycle suite; executed local Chromium fixture with explicit mouse gestures.

criteria.criterion: Produce a bounded product and technical proposal with exact trust/network policy, playback state, archive seek/resume semantics, acceptance checks and rollback; require exact owner approval before production changes.
criteria.evidence: PRODUCT.md and TECH.md match approved SHA-256 values in dispatch packet. Candidate HEAD is c073716626a35d3db189bb814373afaa00864dd0; the implementation changes and tests are committed there. The specs define exact origins, bounded resolver/search, playback lifecycle, acceptance and rollback.
criteria.method: Verified approved spec hashes from dispatch against files and reviewed candidate and source policies; confirmed HEAD is exact dispatched commit.

criteria.criterion: Independent Review and Verify must assess any implemented candidate with real protocol/browser and host evidence, preserving missing evidence honestly.
criteria.evidence: Independent protocol/browser evidence passes: local Chromium with explicit gesture received manifest/media responses 200 on the approved origin, MSE/HLS supported, time advanced, pause/resume/seek succeeded with no error. Saved 2026-11-17 fixture script was rerun on 2026-11-23; redacted output is evidence/run-0fec9b5003c6/local-chromium.json. No authenticated ChatGPT MCP App browser/host trace was available, so actual _meta forwarding, CSP/blob admission in ChatGPT, audible archive playback, prompt routing, and same-browser cross-thread control remain BLOCKED. Owner Android/ChatGPT app session was unavailable; foreground/background/lock-screen, notification, Bluetooth keys/output and idle-only media-key Play remain BLOCKED. These outcomes are not inferred from desktop tests.
criteria.method: Ran npm test (56/56), saved reviewer reproduction (7/7), fresh bounded NTS lookup/resolution and reran the saved local Chromium HLS fixture; checked available host access and prior reports.
